messages.en:
{09 01 00}{09 08 00}{07 14 00}Want to see me do my
impression of you,
{ff 00 00 06}{04 10 00}{ff 00 00 00}? Here, watch!
{ff 00 00 02}{07 1b 00}{ff 00 00 00}"{ff 00 00 02}What's up with your hair?
It looks like someone left
you out in the rain!{ff 00 00 00}"
{07 0b 00}So what do you think,{ff 00 00 02}
{ff 00 00 06}{04 10 00}{ff 00 00 00}? That was
spot-on, huh, {04 02 00}?{09 09 00}
messages.et:
{09 01 00}{09 08 00}{07 14 00}Kas tahad näha, kuidas ma
sind järele teen,
{ff 00 00 06}{04 10 00}{ff 00 00 00}? Vaata!
{ff 00 00 02}{07 1b 00}{ff 00 00 00}„{ff 00 00 02}Mis su juustega on?
Näeb välja, nagu oleks sind
vihma kätte jäetud!{ff 00 00 00}”
{07 0b 00}Mis sa arvad,{ff 00 00 02}
{ff 00 00 06}{04 10 00}{ff 00 00 00}? See oli
täppi, mis, {04 02 00}?{09 09 00}

messages.en:
{09 01 00}{09 08 00}{07 00 00}If I had to say there was
one thing I liked about you,
{ff 00 00 06}{04 10 00}{ff 00 00 00}, it would be...
that you're so confident.
You come right out and say
whatever's on your mind.
.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}{07 16 00}I wish I could do that,
but I guess I'm just too
polite, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 00 00}So, do you have any tips on
how to be more, you know,
{07 0b 00}blunt,{01 00 00 05 00} {ff 00 00 06}{04 10 00}{ff 00 00 00}?{07 00 00}{09 09 00}
messages.et:
{09 01 00}{09 08 00}{07 00 00}Kui ma peaksin ütlema, mis
mulle sinu juures meeldib,
{ff 00 00 06}{04 10 00}{ff 00 00 00}, siis see oleks...
et sa oled nii enesekindel.
Sa ütled otse välja, mis
sul parasjagu mõttes on.
.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}{07 16 00}Soovin, et suudaksin ka,
aga ma olen vist lihtsalt
liiga viisakas, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 00 00}Nii et, kas sul on nippe,
kuidas olla rohkem, noh,
{07 0b 00}otsekohene,{01 00 00 05 00} {ff 00 00 06}{04 10 00}{ff 00 00 00}?{07 00 00}{09 09 00}

messages.en:
{09 00 00}{09 08 00}{09 02 00}{09 06 00}{07 04 00}What? {01 00 00 05 00}That's supposed to be
me?{01 01 00} {07 00 00}I don't think so.

Where's the cutting wit?
Where's the biting, pointed
observation, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
That was just lame. Here,
let me show you how it's
done. This is you.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
{ff 00 00 02}{07 13 00}{ff 00 00 00}"{ff 00 00 06}{04 10 00}{ff 00 00 02} is such a
pretty princess! I wish I
could be more like her!{ff 00 00 00}"{ff 00 00 02}{07 00 00}{09 09 00}
messages.et:
{09 00 00}{09 08 00}{09 02 00}{09 06 00}{07 04 00}Mida? {01 00 00 05 00}See peaks olema
mina?{01 01 00} {07 00 00}Ma ei arva küll.

Kus on lõikav teravus?
Kus on hammustav, täpne
tähelepanek, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
See oli lihtsalt lame.
Las ma näitan, kuidas seda
tehakse. See oled sina.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
{ff 00 00 02}{07 13 00}{ff 00 00 00}„{ff 00 00 06}{04 10 00}{ff 00 00 02} on nii
ilus printsess! Soovin, et
oleksin rohkem tema moodi!{ff 00 00 00}”{ff 00 00 02}{07 00 00}{09 09 00}

messages.en:
{09 00 00}{09 08 00}{09 02 00}{07 00 00}Isn't it obvious? {01 00 00 0a 00}{07 11 00}That was
my impression of the INNER
you, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{ff 00 00 02}{07 06 00}{ff 00 00 00}"{ff 00 00 02}Oh, no! What if {ff 00 00 06}{04 10 00}{ff 00 00 02}
sees me wearing these old
rags! She's so fashionable!{ff 00 00 00}"
{07 14 00}It's OK. I understand. How
could you NOT want to be
me? {01 00 00 05 00}I mean, {07 13 00}look at me!{09 09 00}
messages.et:
{09 00 00}{09 08 00}{09 02 00}{07 00 00}Kas pole ilmne? {01 00 00 0a 00}{07 11 00}See oli
minu mulje sinu SISEMISEST
minast, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{ff 00 00 02}{07 06 00}{ff 00 00 00}„{ff 00 00 02}Oh ei! Kui {ff 00 00 06}{04 10 00}{ff 00 00 02}
näeb mind nendes vanades
kaltsudes! Ta on stiilne!{ff 00 00 00}”
{07 14 00}Pole hullu. Ma mõistan.
Kuidas saaks sa MITTE
tahta olla mina?{01 00 00 05 00} {07 13 00}Vaata!{09 09 00}

messages.en:
{09 00 00}{09 08 00}{09 02 00}{07 00 00}See? It's easy! All you
have to do is not really
care what people think.
{07 15 00}People need honest opinions,
and I'm just the one to
give them to 'em!
Why, {07 16 00}it would be selfish of
me NOT to share my wisdom
with the world!
{07 11 00}The world needs people like
me to tell everyone what's
wrong with them!{09 09 00}
messages.et:
{09 00 00}{09 08 00}{09 02 00}{07 00 00}Näed? See on lihtne! Sa
pead lihtsalt mitte hoolima,
mida teised arvavad.
{07 15 00}Inimesed vajavad ausaid
arvamusi ja mina olen see,
kes neile neid annab!
Noh, {07 16 00}oleks isekas MITTE
jagada oma tarkust
maailmaga!
{07 11 00}Maailm vajab minusuguseid,
kes ütlevad kõigile, mis
nendega viga on!{09 09 00}

messages.en:
{09 00 00}{09 06 00}{09 02 00}{07 14 00}{09 01 00}So, you're saying all I have
to do is tell people what's
wrong with them?
{07 16 00}But what if I hurt their
feelings, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?{09 09 00}
messages.et:
{09 00 00}{09 06 00}{09 02 00}{07 14 00}{09 01 00}Nii et sa ütled, et pean
lihtsalt inimestele ütlema,
mis nendega viga on?
{07 16 00}Aga mis siis, kui ma teen
neile haiget, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?{09 09 00}

messages.en:
{09 00 00}{09 08 00}{09 02 00}{07 15 00}"But"? {01 00 00 05 00}There's no "but" here!
I'm right, and everyone
else is wrong!
{07 01 00}About everything!{01 01 00} {07 14 00}See? It's
all about certainty. There's
no room for doubt!{09 09 00}
messages.et:
{09 00 00}{09 08 00}{09 02 00}{07 15 00}„Aga”? {01 00 00 05 00}Siin pole „aga”!
Mina olen õige ja kõik
teised on valed!
{07 01 00}Kõiges!{01 01 00} {07 14 00}Näed? Kõik sõltub
kindlusest. Kahtlusele pole
ruumi!{09 09 00}

messages.en:
{09 00 00}{09 06 00}{09 01 00}{07 06 00}Hey, maybe you think you
know what's best for
someone, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00},
{07 16 00}but that doesn't give you
the right to make people
feel bad!{09 09 00}
messages.et:
{09 00 00}{09 06 00}{09 01 00}{07 06 00}Kuule, ehk sa arvad, et
tead, mis kellelegi parem
on, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00},
{07 16 00}aga see ei anna sulle õigust
panna inimesi end halvasti
tundma!{09 09 00}

messages.en:
{09 00 00}{09 08 00}{09 02 00}{07 1c 00}You just don't get it, do
you? Oh, well.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.

{07 14 00}Well, on the plus side, that
was pretty blunt and direct
of you, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.{09 01 00}{07 14 00}{09 02 00}
Maybe you'll get the hang of
this after all!
messages.et:
{09 00 00}{09 08 00}{09 02 00}{07 1c 00}Sa lihtsalt ei saa aru,
ega? Ah noh.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.

{07 14 00}Noh, positiivne on see, et
see oli sinust päris
otsekohene, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.{09 01 00}{07 14 00}{09 02 00}
Ehk sa saadki sellest
lõpuks aru!
